title: Daytona Raises $60M in Series B at $1B Valuation for Agent Cloud
summary:
A group of venture capitalists and tech entrepreneurs provided new funding to Daytona to expand the startup's capacity for hosting AI autonomous tools. The company raised $60 million in a Series B round led by FirstMark that values the 35 person team at $1 billion. These funds will be used to build the company's infrastructure into a dedicated system it calls the Agent Cloud.

The financing brings the total amount raised by the startup to $91 million and includes investment from the founders of Perplexity, Shopify, and Zoom. Daytona is hiring across the board to expand its staff, with existing investors and angels also participating in the latest round.
